text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Phew... Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy ran a race that clearly 
proved her undeniable strength, achieving 
great results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her track record is steadily building. 
Aren't many in the crowd already beginning 
to recognize Zenno Rob Roy as a true hero?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, when I pricked up my ears 
just a little—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what an incredible raceee!! The 
spring season is getting seriously hyped 
up now!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is where the real show begins 
this year, right?! Are you all packed and 
ready for Tokyo?"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! There's no way anyone could 
miss this year's NHK Mile Cup, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, that girl who was all the buzz on 
the New Year's special, who'd have thought 
she'd go from the NHK Mile Cup straight to 
the Tokyo Yushun...?!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
With so little time between races, 
conquering both the 1,600m that demands 
pure speed and the 2,400m that demands 
sheer stamina is no ordinary feat.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, even that Tanino Gimlet aimed for it 
time and time again, but couldn't do it!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Still!! That's exactly why you can't help 
but get your hopes up! This time for sure! 
If it's her, she can do it!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
They're saying she'll definitely set a 
grand record worthy of the title "Great 
King"...!!

text_block_list.name: Fans A & B
text_block_list.text: Nggghhhh, I can't wait!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like the New Year's TV special. The 
audience members, talking excitedly 
amongst themselves, left the stands amidst 
the buzzing atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“—So next, I'd like to set my sights on 
the Takarazuka Kinen!”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Grand Prix races draw a whole different 
level of attention, after all. If you're 
aiming to gain widespread recognition, 
it's something worth targeting—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? Um... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Was my proposal really that 
troubling...?
choice_data_list: !! Ah, no... I think it's good!
!! Ah, no... I think it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Is that so...!! What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I look forward to working with 
you on training for the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I still have to keep building on this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy is staying positive. "Even 
if it's plain, step by steady step." She 
is giving it her all to keep doing just 
that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep supporting that too. That's 
how I feel, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An indescribable, eerie sense of unease 
had taken root in my heart before I even 
realized it.
